Name: Slime Mods
Author: SadDodo
Description:
What each mod does:

Slime QoL: Adds some quality of life patches
1. Prevents the slimed debuff from slowing the player
2. Prevents the player from taking damage from slimes
3. Slimes don't attack/jump at the player
4. The player can walk through the slimes
5. The slimes can talk! They have different things to say depending on their hp (Thresholds are 200, 100, 0)

Minigame: Turns the Slime Hutch into a dangerous place for slimes! If the slimes aren't on the right color tile, they might die!

Slime Qol Alt: Same thing as Slime Qol but the slimes will target the player
                (I suggest you use this with the minigame otherwise the slimes will just wander around and die)
